multiplicity_disclosure.rationale: no formal family-wise (Bonferroni/Benjamini-Hochberg) correction is applied anywhere in this milestone. Every one of the 39 Work Package N Wilcoxon tests already carries its own 'n too small for a confident test; supplementary only' disclosure in its own output -- at n=8 per test, a correction would leave essentially no power to detect anything, so results are read descriptively (paired-difference direction and magnitude, outcome-label transition counts) rather than as a battery of confirmatory p<0.05 claims. Work Package K's multi-metric/multi-k reporting is explicitly Section 9.3's own anti-p-hacking design (report everything, privilege nothing) rather than a hypothesis-testing multiplicity problem.
